newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q1 GDP up 0.2 pct vs Q4,off 1.0 pct vs Q1 96.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q1 GDP up 0.2 pct vs Q4,off 1.0 pct vs Q1 96.

text.p: Swiss Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rose at an annual, seasonally-adjusted rate of 0.2 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the fourth quarter of 1996, the Federal Office for Economic Policy said.
Versus the first quarter of 1996, the GDP fell one percent.

The Office also said the fourth quarter 1996 GDP fell by 1.2 percent versus the previous quarter, revised down from a previously reported unchanged reading in the fourth quarter 1996 versus the third quarter 1996.
